text: Vista is the trade name of Vista Global Holding Limited, the Dubai-headquartered private aviation group behind the Vista AF Corse team name and livery; Vista's own materials list VistaJet and XO as its brands.
short: Vista (the Vista AF Corse team name/livery brand) is the trade name of Vista Global Holding Limited; VistaJet and XO are Vista brands.

source.name: PR Newswire (release by Vista) – Vista AF Corse showcases its striking FIA world ensurance championship livery, as battle gears up for Le Mans
source.quote: Vista Global Holding Limited (Vista) is the world's leading global business aviation company
source.note: The same release's About Vista section says its services are offered through its leading brands, including VistaJet and XO.

additionalSources.name: Vista Global – Vista AF Corse team page (site footer)
additionalSources.quote: "Vista" is a trade name for Vista Global Holding Limited.
additionalSources.note: Footer legal line, present on every vistaglobal.com page.
